appearances.title: JetBrains releases Mellum2.1 Instruct, a 12B-A2.5B open coding model for sub-agents and tool loops, with an MTP head
appearances.headline: JetBrains releases Mellum2.1 Instruct open 12B coding model
appearances.newly_possible: Builders can now run a 12B-A2.5B open MoE coding model tuned for sub-agents and tool loops that uses roughly half the tokens of Mellum2.1 Thinking and adds an MTP head for up to 1.8x faster generation.
appearances.why: Fast, low-token local coding models make multi-step sub-agents and tight IDE tool loops viable on laptops like an M3 Pro at 25 to 30 tokens per second.
appearances.limits: Token savings and 1.8x speedup come from the release post, and no exact benchmark scores or license are listed.
